title: Contrast token mapping & bidirectional keyboard-navigation audit for Costview and Rollouts cards
creator: Sofia Park
description: Audit and prototype a set of UI fixes for Costview cards and Rollouts dashboard tiles to address WCAG contrast gaps, keyboard navigation inconsistencies, and bidirectional (RTL) layout issues. Deliver a token-mapping spec (light/dark) with recommended implementation snippets, an annotated Figma prototype, and a prioritized engineering tickets list. Goal is to remove blocking accessibility and localization regressions before the 2026.03 console release.
acceptance_criteria: All text and icon color combinations on Costview cards and Rollouts tiles meet WCAG AA contrast ratio 4.5:1 for normal text (3:1 for large text) in both light and dark themes
Keyboard-only users can: tab into each card, reach and activate CTA buttons, and use arrow keys to traverse carousel-like rollout items where applicable
Focus visible state uses a high-contrast design token and is visible in both themes without relying solely on color
RTL/Arabic/Hebrew locales mirror layout correctly, truncation preserves affordances, and caret/tab order is logical in RTL
Number and currency formats respect user locale (i18n) and do not rely on color-only differences to convey meaning
Design tokens are documented, mapped to implementation variables, and include fallback tokens for older client platforms
Annotated Figma prototype and a short implementation checklist are linked from this ticket
decisions: Prefer adjusting semantic color tokens (text-primary, icon-muted, bg-surface) over creating ad-hoc component-level overrides to keep token usage consistent across console
Use 3px outline + token-based focus ring for edge cases where contrast cannot be achieved by color changes without impacting brand colors
For rollout cards that act like lists, implement roving tabindex with arrow-key support (aria-activedescendant) rather than custom key handlers attached to each element
Defer currency abbreviation changes to PM — this ticket ensures readable locale-aware formatting only
Where contrast ratio cannot meet 4.5:1 due to branding constraints, flag as "+design exception" and propose a motion (larger text or background lift) with PM/Eng sign-off
notes: Initial automated scan (axe + pa11y) found 12 contrast failures across Costview tiles in dark theme and 3 keyboard order issues on Rollouts preview
Manual review with screen reader (NVDA) highlighted missing aria-labels on incremental cost delta badges
Engineering raised concerns about perf when adding extra DOM nodes for focus rings — exploring CSS-only focus-within patterns
Localization team requested a check for number group separators in compact card layout to avoid line breaks that hide affordances
